resource.title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3
resource.covers: 第 4 章：多元链式法则（4.5）、方向导数与梯度（4.6）；第 5.7 节：多重积分换元公式与雅可比行列式（坐标变换）。向量值映射的雅可比矩阵在 4.5 的链式法则与 5.7 的换元中体现。

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: MATH 18 or MATH 31AH and MATH 20C or MATH 31BH with a grade of C– or better.

Prerequisites: knowledge of basic computer science principles and skills at a level sufficient to write a reasonably non-trivial computer program in Python/NumPy to the equivalency of CS106A or CS106B, familiarity with probability theory to the equivalency of CS 109 or MATH151, and familiarity with multivariable calculus and linear algebra to the equivalency of MATH51 or CS205L.

notes: UCSD 20E 的课程内容本身包含 Jacobian、gradient fields，其官方先修明确要求 MATH 18/31AH（线性代数）和 MATH 20C/31BH（偏微分、二重积分）；CS229 也把 multivariable calculus 与 linear algebra 写进 Prerequisites。两个建议前置都有官方原文支持。
